decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer sits close to the core offer and involved substantial in-house development and public presentation, so dropping it after a year would write off that investment while weak early results can still be read as normal market ramp-up.

The numbering software module was publicly announced as an extension of the software portfolio and fits the declared direction of digitalization and serialization, so management is committed to it and its upkeep costs little.

The coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds on established ink and technology expertise, is shown on the website, and serves the firm's one-stop solution claim, so there is no reason to abandon it within a year of launch.
